spec.label: Manifest Table
spec.description: Generate a portable table from a manifest runtime provider.

spec.label: Manifest Table Offset
spec.description: Offset the value column using a second provider from the same package.

python.source:
def execute(params, upstream, context):
    result = upstream.copy()
    result['value'] = result['value'] + float(params.get('amount', 0))
    return result
